user_story:
As a user, I want to receive notification messages when I perform certain actions so that I can be informed about the success or failure of those actions.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When the user clicks on the link with text 'Click here', a notification message should be displayed in the div with id 'flash-messages'.
2. The page URL should remain as 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/notification_message_rendered'.
3. The footer with id 'page-footer' should be visible, containing the text 'Powered by Elemental Selenium'.
